dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the anterior mid-back towards the visible posterior section.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and appear largely linear with no visible asymmetrical bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; median intensity is high in the illuminated portion of the dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp, high-contrast linear transition between the reflective white dorsal surface and the dark blue-toned shadowed flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct longitudinal illumination divide splitting the dorsal plane into high-contrast white and dark-blue halves.
